<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/users/me/credentials/{provider}/test"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The check is an explicit action, separate from registration (ADR 0050): the api decrypts the secret, calls the provider, and returns ONLY the verdict — the key never comes back, not even in part. Responds 200 for all three outcomes, because the request was processed; `refused` is an outcome, not a protocol error. 404 when there is no credential for (user, provider) — then there is nothing to test.
